entities.name: Three Kingdoms Rivalry
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The division into three rival Malla kingdoms — Kathmandu, Lalitpur (Patan), and Bhaktapur — whose architectural competition produced Durbar Squares, the Nyatapola Temple, and some of the finest pagodas in the world.
